title: GroupMemberAddRequest
description: Add a member to a group (POST /v1/groups/{id}/members body). Owner-or-admin only. The `subject` is resolved server-side exactly like a share grantee: a value containing ':' is a full 'issuer:subject' kept verbatim, '@service:<subject>' is a service account kept colon-free, and a bare BV-BRC username is prefixed to 'bvbrc:<username>'. The resolved subject is echoed back so a typo is visible. A never-logged-in user is pre-provisioned so the membership is claimed on first login. Group ids and the '@public'/'@group:' forms are rejected (no nesting).

subject.description: Who to add. A full 'issuer:subject' string (kept verbatim), '@service:<subject>' for a service account (kept colon-free — a bare subject would be qualified to 'bvbrc:<subject>' and the membership would expand for a federated identity that never authenticates), or a bare BV-BRC username (prefixed to 'bvbrc:<username>').

issuer.description: Issuer used to qualify a bare username (default 'bvbrc'). Ignored for an '@service:<subject>' form and for a value that already contains ':'.
